title: Projects with a pulse.
intro: A growing archive of personal and academic work. Each project is a chance to make a system clearer than I found it.

items.name: AeroDent
items.description: Turning a complex clinic workflow into a simple offline application for patient records, appointments, and treatment history.
items.idea: Make everyday clinic work easier to hold in one place.
items.problem: Important clinical information was spread across workflows that needed more structure and clarity.
items.build: A bilingual management system with patient records, odontograms, appointments, prescriptions, image records, and local-first handling.

items.name: Quizland
items.description: Building a learning platform that turns quiz management into a clearer experience for students, teachers, and administrators.
items.idea: Make practice feel like progress instead of pressure.
items.problem: Educational content needed a more practical way to move between learning, assessment, and administration.
items.build: A full-stack Flask experience with quiz and content management, student and teacher flows, and administrative tools.

items.name: My Stickies
items.description: A personal and business project that turns custom physical products into a more thoughtful online store experience.
items.idea: Give small creative products a place that feels as considered as the products themselves.
items.problem: A growing collection of stickers, planners, posters, bookmarks, and name tags needed a clearer way to be discovered.
items.build: A custom storefront direction shaped around product presentation, practical browsing, and a personal maker identity.
